subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar a organização de texto dramático apresentado em teatro, televisão, cinema, identificando e percebendo os sentidos decorrentes dos recursos linguísticos e semióticos que sustentam sua realização como peça teatral, novela, filme etc.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos estruturais de textos dramáticos através de teatro, televisão e formatos cinematográficos
components.description_en: Identify the structural elements of dramatic texts across theater, television, and film formats
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters

components.description_pt: Analisar recursos linguísticos em texto dramático e interpretar significados que produzem
components.description_en: Analyze linguistic resources in a dramatic text and interpret the meanings they produce
components.cc_component_description: Identify figurative language and interpret its meaning within a given text

components.description_pt: Analisar recursos semióticos—encenação, som, imagem—que sustentam realização dramática em diferentes mídias
components.description_en: Analyze semiotic resources—staging, sound, image—that sustain dramatic realization in different media
components.cc_component_description: Contrast how sound or staging in a multimedia version shapes audience experience versus a written text

components.description_pt: Interpretar como mesmo texto dramático gera significados distintos entre palco, tela e formatos televisivos
components.description_en: Interpret how the same dramatic text generates distinct meanings across stage, screen, and television formats
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different media or formats present the same information and assess their relative effectiveness

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Interpret words and phrases as they are used in a text, including determining technical, connotative, and figurative meanings, and analyze how specific word choices shape meaning or tone.

Compare and contrast a written story, drama, or poem to its audio, filmed, staged, or multimedia version, analyzing the effects of techniques unique to each medium (e.g., lighting, sound, color, or camera focus and angles in a film).
Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in different media or formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively) as well as in words in order to address a question or solve a problem.
